fused_defaults.knob: fused defaults: linear, auto semantic floor, tinybert floor 0.3
fused_defaults.project_toml:
[kimetsu]
project_id = "kimetsu-e0-config-77lb2ra"
schema_version = 1
use_user_brain = false
mcp_write_tools = true

[model]
provider = "anthropic"
model = "claude-opus-4-7"
api_key_env = "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
max_output_tokens = 8192
temperature = 0.2
request_timeout_secs = 120
region_env = "AWS_REGION"

[broker]
default_budget_tokens = 6000
max_capsules = 8
min_semantic_score = -1.0
min_lexical_coverage = 0.5
fusion = "linear"
normalization = "per_kind"
abstain_min_score = -1.0
rerank_min_score = 0.3
explicit_fact_guard = false
budget_floor_tokens = 1500
budget_run_cap_tokens = 8000
ambient = true
compress_capsules = true
session_dedupe = false
warm_start = false
answer_grade_min_score = 0.92
proactive_prefetch = false

[broker.weights]
relevance = 0.5
confidence = 0.2
freshness = 0.2
scope = 0.1
decay_half_life_days = 30.0

[broker.weights.localization]
relevance = 0.7
confidence = 0.1
freshness = 0.1
scope = 0.1

[broker.weights.patch_plan]
relevance = 0.4
confidence = 0.3
freshness = 0.1
scope = 0.2

[broker.weights.verification]
relevance = 0.4
confidence = 0.1
freshness = 0.4
scope = 0.1

[broker.weights.review]
relevance = 0.5
confidence = 0.2
freshness = 0.2
scope = 0.1

[shell]
default_timeout_secs = 60
max_timeout_secs = 600
env_allowlist_extra = [
    "RUSTFLAGS",
    "CARGO_HOME",
]
redact_secrets = true

[ingestion]
max_file_bytes = 524288
extra_skip_dirs = []
max_total_files = 50000
detect_conflicts = true
resolve_conflicts = false
initial_importance_scoring = true
quality_filter_enabled = true
quality_filter_novelty_threshold = 0.9
quality_filter_min_len = 10
quality_filter_max_len = 500
transient_ttl_days = 7

[run]
max_total_tool_calls = 60
max_total_model_turns = 30
max_total_cost_usd = 250.0

[embedder]
model = "bge-small-en-v1.5"
enabled = true
daemon = true
warm_on_start = true
reranker = "ms-marco-tinybert-l-2-v2"

[learning]
auto_harvest = true
store_queries = true

[learning.distiller]
enabled = false
provider = "anthropic"
model = "claude-haiku-4-5"
api_key_env = "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
base_url_env = "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL"
region_env = "AWS_REGION"

[storage]
backend = "graph-lite"

[sync]
machine_id = ""
auto = true

[lifecycle]
forget_enabled = false
forget_min_age_days = 90
forget_usefulness_floor = -0.1
forget_protect_use_count = 10
regret_flag_threshold = 5
proposal_expiry_days = 30
proposal_auto_accept_confidence = 1.1

[retrieval]
level = "deep"

[decisions]
provider = "disabled"
